changes: Scene actor preparation starts independent combat-texture, plant-motion, boss, animation and pea-art work together.

All four Assets.load image call sites (board/combat textures, motion atlases, effect pages and boss parts) share a FIFO pool of three occupied image-load slots. Atlas slots include the paired metadata/image wait and explicit GPU upload.
Nested batches wait for all started work before propagating the original failure, allowing safe release and retry.
No new images, gameplay/model changes, per-frame work, dependencies or render-resolution changes.

tests.lifecycleLog: output/并行加载-生命周期复验.log

before.scope: Observed desktop Safari UI and saved screenshot;4 independent resource families each receive500ms artificial delay, not physical iPhone or a real-network benchmark.

after.scope: 桌面Safari受控加载；四组资源各额外等待500ms，用来测串行等待，非真实网络或iPhone测速

controlledLatency.scope: Same real Scene;500ms simulated latency per family. Browser cache resource-byte counters were unavailable (0), so this is not download-size evidence and not a phone/network speed claim.

realBrowserResourceLifetime.scope: Controlled dev-server scenes, injected failure, retry,12 switches through all scenery and boss, release and revisit. Counts inspect owned sources, including shared blink atlas. RGBA values estimate one uncompressed copy, not process/GPU memory.

remaining: Physical iPhone Safari network, touch, sound activation, thermal/battery and total process memory acceptance.

Chrome showed535MB tab memory after the12-switch development fixture despite zero stale owned sources. This does not prove a production leak or a low total-memory budget; production-profile memory and browser-cache/GC behavior still require separate investigation.
Overall1:1 game fidelity is still partial; this change only removes loading serialization and bounds image work.
